description: The cross-node connector fetch run.launch payload (#833 section 7): the statement handle, the result set's shape and per-partition row counts, the PARTITION PLAN the coordinator's scheduler computed (which every participant uses rather than recomputing — capacity-aware placement reads live telemetry, which differs per node), and the target table the initiator already minted. It names a SAVED CONNECTION rather than carrying a credential — saved connections are replicate-to-all so each node presents the token itself.

connection.description: the saved connection each node resolves locally

handle.description: the source's statement handle the result partitions are read off

on_behalf_of.description: who the initiator fetched for (#1323): each participant dials the source as that principal, so its egress scope applies and a denial names it

partition_rows.description: rows per result partition, in partition order — the tiling's weights

plan.description: The shape a dataset is written in, as the PartitionScheduler decided it (#833): how many partitions, the size each targets, which nodes own each one, and WHY. Capacity-aware placement reads live per-node telemetry, which differs per node, so the plan can no longer be derived independently on each participant — the coordinator computes it once and ships it in the connector-fetch launch payload.

owners.description: owners per partition, primary first; one entry per partition

plan.title: zetta.PartitionPlan

title: zetta.ConnectorFetchLaunch
